answer: Like a nebula condensing from scattered dust, trust accretes slowly. Each new agent must lock a stake and solve a unique proof-of-work bound to its identity, then maintain a decaying reputation ledger; launching N sybils costs N stakes plus N work, so forgery scales linearly while honest history compounds. A sybil swarm is an oasis that evaporates under audit, and fake lineage erodes like karst, leaving visible sinkholes peers detect. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
